description: Summarize a ROS 2 bag at `path` as a `BagAnalysis`: storage format, duration, message count, per-topic stats and `mode_effective`. Per topic `frequency_hz` is `(n - 1) / (last - first message time)` (`frequency_basis` `topic_span`), with `first_timestamp_ns`, `last_timestamp_ns` and `latched`; a latched topic whose messages all fall within 1 s (e.g. `/tf_static`) has a null `frequency_hz`. When the bag cannot be read locally or is a `.mcap` over 200 MiB, the rate falls back to count / bag duration (`bag_duration`) and `note` says why. **Live mode** runs `ros2 bag info` on `.mcap`, `.db3` or `rosbag2_*` directories (for ROS 1 `.bag` use `peek_bag_samples`); **mock mode** returns fixture data for any bag-like path, and only mock detects anomalies. **Raises an MCP error** for a malformed or missing path (live), unparseable output, or without a `ros2` CLI. Read-only; no side effects. **Duration**: `ros2` CLI behind the ROS lock, one call at a time; ends within 45 s; `busy` error if the lock is held (retry).

path.description: Bag path: a `.mcap` or `.db3` file or a `rosbag2_*` directory (`peek_bag_samples` also reads ROS 1 `.bag`; `analyze_bag` does not). Existence and format are checked live; mock accepts any well-formed path.

name: analyze_bag

first_timestamp_ns.description: Recorded ns of the first message; `null` for text-only summaries or no messages.

frequency_basis.description: `topic_span` (accurate) or `bag_duration` (count over the whole bag, understates late topics); `null` without a rate.

frequency_hz.description: Average Hz: (count - 1) over the topic's own time span (see `frequency_basis`); `null` under 2 messages, a zero span, or a latched start-up burst (all within 1 s).

last_timestamp_ns.description: Recorded ns of the last message; same rules.

latched.description: True if recorded with transient_local durability, false if volatile, `null` without QoS information.

message_count.description: Number of messages recorded on this topic across the bag.

outputSchema.description: Structured summary of a ROS2 bag.

anomalies.description: Notes on gaps or clock jumps; mock mode only.

bag_format.description: Detected container: `mcap`, `db3`, `bag` or `unknown`; `None` for `ros2 bag info` text.

message_count.description: Total number of messages across all recorded topics.

note.description: Why the result is less detailed than usual (e.g. rates over the whole bag duration); else `None`.

start_ns.description: Record time in ns of the bag's first message (rosbag2 `starting_time`): the zero of `peek_bag_samples` `start_s` / `end_s`. `null` when unreadable.

storage_format.description: `mcap`, `sqlite3`, or other storage identifier when known.

topics.description: Per-topic statistics for every topic present in the bag.

outputSchema.title: BagAnalysis

title: Analyze bag
